notes: 5 acceptance_matrix criteria covered: 1 backend test file + 6 browser checks (one criterion got both backend+browser since it's API-backed UI). Two checks mutated seeded data (ahmad's profile fields, Sara Al-Masri's application status on Backend Developer Trainee) during verification and were restored to their original values via direct API calls immediately after the check ran; restoration verified by a follow-up GET showing original values (course/skill/language counts back to 7/6/2, GPA back to 3.36; all 4 applicant statuses back to 'pending').

checks.criterion: Profile list rows use stable keys (code-review fix): removing a middle row keeps other rows' own state
checks.name: profile-stable-keys-on-remove
checks.evidence: Added 3 rows each to External courses, Projects and Skills tabs on ahmad's profile (no save clicked, so DB unaffected - confirmed via GET /api/student/profile showing external_courses=2, projects=2, skills=6 after the check). Typed un-submitted draft text in the last row's tag input (TagInput commits on blur, so draft became a chip), removed the middle new row, and asserted the remaining last row kept its own title and its own draft/chip value, with the removed row's title ('TscheckExtB'/'TscheckProjB'/'TscheckSkillB') absent from every remaining row. Same pattern verified for Projects (tech tag input) and Skills (name+level buttons).

checks.criterion: Profile add/edit/remove + save still works after the key refactor
checks.name: profile-save-add-edit-remove-persist
checks.evidence: Added course 'Cloud Computing' grade A, added skill 'Docker' advanced, removed language 'English', clicked profile-save-btn -> toast 'Profile saved' shown. Reloaded page: course-name-7='Cloud Computing', skill-name-6='Docker', language index 1 gone, language-name-0='Arabic' still present. GPA badge updated from 3.36 to 3.44. Profile restored to original values afterward via PUT /api/student/profile with pre-check snapshot; GET confirmed restoration (7 courses, 6 skills, 2 languages, gpa 3.36).

checks.criterion: Match scores unchanged after compute_match() refactor into per-factor functions
checks.name: test_tscheck_match_scores
checks.evidence: GET /api/student/recommendations as ahmad -> 200, 9 opportunities, totals sorted desc [96.6, 78.2, 62.5, 61.0, 54.9, 50.8, 49.5, 33.0, 28.8]; every match.factors has exactly keys/weights {major:25,courses:25,skills:25,external:10,interests:10,location:5} and total == round(sum(points),1) for all rows. Second test confirms GET without auth -> 401/403. `python -m pytest tests/test_tscheck_match_scores.py` 2 passed.

checks.criterion: Match scores unchanged after compute_match() refactor into per-factor functions (UI: score ring + Why this score dialog)

checks.evidence: /student/opportunities renders opp-card-* with a score ring (opp-score-*) showing e.g. '97%', and clicking opp-why-* opens a dialog listing exactly 6 factor-<key> rows (major, courses, skills, external, interests, location).

checks.name: company-applicant-ranking-and-status
checks.evidence: Logged in as recruiter@techventures.jo, opened Backend Developer Trainee applicants: 4 applicant-score-* rings read descending (matches API order 96/70/49/49). Why-this-score dialog opens with 6 factor rows. Clicked applicant-set-accepted then applicant-set-rejected on Sara Al-Masri's application (id c4d8d608...) and confirmed the status badge updated to 'Accepted' then 'Rejected'; reset back to 'Pending' at end of check. GET /api/company/opportunities/.../applicants afterward confirms all 4 applications are back to status 'pending'.
